segments.ja318:1.3: Sāmaṃ bāhāya pīḷesi, sā taṃ ārogyamabravi.
segments.ja318:2.1: Ambho na kira saddheyyaṃ, yaṃ vāto pabbataṃ vahe;
segments.ja318:2.3: Pabbatañce vahe vāto, sabbampi pathaviṃ vahe;
segments.ja318:2.5: Yattha sāmā kālakatā [kālaṅkatā (ka.)], sā maṃ ārogyamabravi.
segments.ja318:3.1: Na ceva sā kālakatā, na ca sā aññamicchati;
segments.ja318:3.3: Ekabhattikinī [ekabhattā kira (sī. syā.), ekabhattakinī (pī.)] sāmā, tameva abhikaṅkhati.
segments.ja318:4.1: Asanthutaṃ maṃ cirasanthutena [asandhataṃ maṃ cirasandhatena (ka.)], nimīni sāmā adhuvaṃ dhuvena;
segments.ja318:4.3: Mayāpi sāmā nimineyya aññaṃ, ito ahaṃ dūrataraṃ gamissanti.
